title: Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan: Plans Held per Vehicle and per Host
content:
A plan of the Keyturn Vehicle Care Plan covers one vehicle. From that single fact the whole of the marketplace's position on holdings follows, and it is set out here as the servicing desk applies it.

### The rule

A care plan covers one vehicle, so a host may hold as many plans as they have vehicles and there is no ceiling on the number. One vehicle carries one live plan, and a second application on a vehicle already on a plan is a plan change rather than a second plan. Each plan carries its own allowance and its own spend ceiling, and an allowance unused on one vehicle is never drawn on for another.

### The same rule, answered as it is asked

*A host with four vehicles on the marketplace asks how many care plans they may hold.* Four, one against each vehicle, and no ceiling stands above that: the number of plans a host may hold is bounded only by the number of vehicles they have.

*A host whose vehicle is already on a plan applies for a second plan on the same vehicle.* The vehicle carries one live plan, so what is being asked for is a plan change on the plan the vehicle already holds, not a second plan beside it.

*A host holding two plans asks whether the services and the spend ceiling left on one vehicle may go toward work on the other.* They may not. The allowance and the spend ceiling belong to the plan, which covers one vehicle, and what is unused on one vehicle is never drawn on for the other.

### Points of judgement

The ceiling that matters here is the count of the host's own vehicles, not a count the marketplace sets; and the object that carries an allowance is always the plan on one vehicle, never the host.
